context: Final cleaned production implementation. No other task-started local validation or build runs concurrently. Fresh browser profiles; shared Vite servers and OS caches. Current eager versus owned APIs, not a frozen historical executable.
methodology: Real advertisement app and UI switch buttons, built library, fresh Chromium profile per trial. Current eager compatibility API versus owned API; not a historical executable. Loopback network/module/font startup included. Owned-store counters observe only advertisement themes (eager results are not bound to that registry), not mount-cycle owners. Blob counters are global to the page. Two frame boundaries and one task precede consistent post-GC sampling. Post-GC CDP heap/backing-storage and sum of browser-process RSS are recorded separately from asset counters. Twenty public mount/disconnect cycles follow app teardown. Telemetry and hooks exist only in this local server.
